svg.title: Intervention-conditioned response laws
svg.desc: What this figure shows: Different interventions can induce distinguishable future response distributions, the primitive objects of the causal-structure construction. The plotted object is generated from P_p^(u,tau) = Law(Y_(t+tau) | do(u), p). How to read it: compare the labeled axes, curves, contours, matrix entries, bars, or markers exactly as defined in the atlas entry; the visible trend is the numerical realization of the stated equation or construction. Scientific status: Synthetic intervention benchmark. Unless explicitly identified otherwise, this is not empirical consciousness data.
